data.text:
SB19 Announces Dubai Stop for Simula at Wakas World Tour at Coca-Cola Arena This October, Global Momentum Continues After Sold-Out North American Run 

 MANILA, PHILIPPINES — Following the surprise reveal of their Japan concert in Tokyo this September, SB19 is taking their global domination even further with the announcement of their Simula at Wakas World Tour stop in Dubai, UAE, performing live at the Coca-Cola Arena on October 11, 2025.  

The news comes just as the group wraps up their sold-out 7-city tour across North America, including explosive performances in Redwood City, Anaheim, Toronto, Calgary, Vancouver, Temecula, and Hawaii. SB19’s unstoppable energy and global reach have been met with deafening cheers, packed arenas, and historic moments, from drone tributes to official city recognitions.  

The tour now heads back to Asia with another wave of high-demand shows:  

* August 24 – Singapore (Arena @ Expo) — Limited tickets left  

*September 13 & 14 – Hong Kong (MacPherson Stadium) — Both nights SOLD OUT  

* September 24 – Tokyo, Japan (Zepp Haneda) — Just announced  

Now, the Dubai stop adds fuel to the fire. General onsale begins August 8, 2025 via https://t.co/aMdz9i6wOx. Fans across the Middle East are expected to turn out in full force as this marks SB19’s grand return to the region.

With no signs of slowing down, SB19 is proving to be not just a P-pop powerhouse, but a global music phenomenon redefining what it means to represent Filipino music on the world stage.
